hero.title: Shruti
hero.subtitle: All Vedic wisdom in one app. Lectures of A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada.
hero.lead: Deep ideas in plain words — the soul, consciousness, karma and the meaning of life. Listen on your commute, on a walk or at home, and come back to what matters whenever you like.
seo.title: Shruti — A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada
seo.description: Vedic wisdom in one app: lectures on the soul, karma and the meaning of life. Listen online or offline.
features.title: Features
features.lead: Everything you need to study the scriptures every day — listen, read, and return to what matters.
feature.library.d: Thousands of lectures on the Bhagavad-gita, Srimad-Bhagavatam and other Vedic scriptures. A full-text catalog with filters by author, place, source, tag and language — always at hand.
feature.transcript.d: The transcript runs with the audio and highlights the current sentence as the lecture plays. Tap a line to jump there, or select text to copy and share.
feature.bookmarks.d: Select a passage right in the transcript and save a bookmark. Notes are searchable and shareable, and tapping one takes you back to the exact second of the recording.
feature.search.d: Find lectures by title, source, author or date. Full-text search and precise filters get you to the topic or passage of scripture in seconds.
feature.offline.d: Download lectures together with their transcript and listen offline — on the road, in flight, or wherever there is no signal. The catalog and texts work without a connection too.
feature.chat.d: Ask about the soul, karma or the meaning of life. The assistant answers from the lecture corpus and cites exact passages — verses, purports and timestamps — so you can hear the source right away.
feature.share.d: Turn any passage into an audio clip, a short video or a transcript quote and send it to friends — with a link back to the lecture itself.
feature.streak.d: An “up next” queue is always ready for the next lecture, while an activity heatmap and a day-streak counter show your practice growing.

ai.band.title: Ask — in chat, or in your own AI
ai.band.lead: Answers grounded in scripture and Śrīla Prabhupāda's lectures. Ask in our chat, or connect the corpus to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.
aiAgent.title: Ask Sadhu — grounded in lectures and scripture
aiAgent.lead: A spiritual assistant that answers your questions grounded only in recorded lectures and scripture — with a precise link to the source. It never makes things up.
aiAgent.f1.d: Finds the exact moment in a recording and lets you hear that very fragment — with the author, title and date of the lecture.
aiAgent.f2.d: Verses from the Bhagavad-gita, Srimad-Bhagavatam and other scriptures — in the original, with translation and Srila Prabhupada's verbatim purports.
aiAgent.f3.d: Semantic search across thousands of lectures, verses, commentaries, book chapters and letters — by meaning, not keyword match.
aiAgent.f4.d: Points you to the exact canto, chapter or verse where a story or topic is found — an address, not a retelling.
aiAgent.f5.d: It answers only from the sources it finds. If the corpus has nothing on a topic, it says so honestly instead of inventing an answer.
aiAgent.f6.d: Every statement is verifiable — the answer leads to a specific recording, verse or book by Srila Prabhupada.
watch.band.title: Why does listening matter?
watch.band.lead: Hearing — śravaṇam — is the first and foremost practice of spiritual life: not your own speculation or conclusions, but knowledge received from someone within the tradition. In these short clips, devotees who heard Śrīla Prabhupāda in person share why simply hearing about Kṛṣṇa matters so much — and how attentive listening gradually opens the heart.

faq.1.q: How much does the app cost?
faq.1.a: The basics are free: listen to lectures, read transcripts, bookmark passages. A PRO subscription adds the smart library and advanced features.
faq.2.a: Yes — you can try PRO free for 14 days. Cancel any time before the trial ends.
faq.3.q: What does a PRO subscription include?
faq.3.a: A smart library with personal recommendations and the full power of Ask Sadhu. Listening, transcripts and bookmarks stay free.
faq.4.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
faq.4.a: In your App Store or Google Play settings. PRO stays active until the end of the paid period.
faq.5.q: Do I need an internet connection?
faq.5.a: No. Download lectures in advance and listen offline — on your commute, on a walk, anywhere.
faq.6.a: iPhone, iPad and Android. Get it on the App Store or Google Play.
faq.7.q: What languages are the lectures in?
faq.7.a: The library has lectures in English and Russian. The app interface is translated into many languages.
faq.8.a: An assistant that searches the lecture corpus and gives a clear answer with links to the specific recordings.
